why: The shape of the incident that made `pkg verify` exist: relative imports across a package. One dot from a sibling, two dots climbing out of a nested package. When this broke in the real repo, 91% of a package looked unimported and 204 passing tests said nothing — so this case is the standing regression guard for import resolution, and the only one where a drop to zero has already happened once in production.
excluded: Nothing. This case is deliberately free of hard shapes — every fact in it should resolve, and any miss is a regression rather than a known limit.
